scope: Exact source delta review of original F0 receipt/denominator binding and closed SQL projection; no original archive or native execution.
observations: F0 prepared, execution and finalization receipts must have the fixed schemas and exact source/tree. The fixed workload is compared through canonical JSON so boolean/numeric substitutions do not compare equal.

The planned denominator remains exactly six phase/round identities at the fixed scheduled offsets and 42 phase/packet identities. Boolean observation flags, nonnegative integer attempts and recorded SLO count are checked; execution and finalization denominator records must agree.

Prepared/execution/report payload hashes are tied to the inspected files, and the original finalization complete_success must remain false. This does not independently recalculate original SLO physics or qualify the native binary.

SQL additions use closed field and literal sets. Unknown strings, fields and error values still go through the unchanged opaque projection. The raw download, archive validation, common projection and output-budget functions are byte-identical to the baseline.

Review identified that calls_started would remain opaque in SQL projection because its fixed label was missing. The exact 92-byte follow-up adds that label and an explicit synthetic equality check; no other final-candidate byte differs from the first candidate.
limitations: No Python controls, artifact downloads, native binaries or archived source were executed in this review.
Recorded SQL values are diagnostic observations; this review does not independently remeasure SQL CPU or validate all producer arithmetic.
The original common network/ZIP code was compared for unchanged bytes, not fully re-audited.
The manifest's campaign/F0 source bindings are explicit; original_binary_verified remains false for F0.
